Between these two paths, the Davas, which lead to the Drewge, those who chose infatuation over counsel also made the worst decision. They rushed together towards violence, believing demons would control them through it. You must choose goodness despite evil. If people lie, you tell the truth; your actions matter most.

When their punishment comes for their sins, master, at thy command shall good thoughts establish dominion in consummation for those who deliver lies or harara into the hands of right. God will know what good and evil you did when you die; it is the final judgment.

This idea marks the beginning of monotheism. As you can see, this echoes in Christianity and Islam too. The world of lie shall be destroyed by light, but those who achieve a good name will share in the promised reward in the fair abolish of good thought. Do what is virtuous not only for God's reward but your own eternal happiness.

In the beginning, Amass created individuality through spirit and powers of understanding, making life clothed with a body where actions and teachings allow one to exercise convictions freely. When we choose Asha, we do God's work; in our hearts, choosing Asha changes the world for the better.

All prophets are divinely inspired, speaking certain truths. By understanding other prophets, we gain insight into Zoroastrian thinking. Roomi, considered the greatest Persian poet, lived about 2,000 to 3,000 years after Zorathustra and is thought to be his reincarnation. We will read his poetry to understand the cosmology of Zorashinism.
